Audio effects are registered by Soundscaper. Effects whose ID begins with `audacity-` are adapted from Audacity 3.7.7 at [`5ef610ed2326`](https://github.com/audacity/audacity/tree/Audacity-3.7.7); the pitch and tempo effects use the StaffPad time and pitch library pinned to Audacity 4.0.0 at [`4c177d436e48`](https://github.com/audacity/audacity/tree/4c177d436e48c1d20f231eada44035593cb26292). Every other effect is written for this repository.

“Realtime rack” means the effect can sit in a track or master rack and process audio while it plays. “Selection” means the effect can be previewed and applied destructively to a selected range. An effect can do both.

## Why some effects are selection-only

These effects cannot be a realtime insert, because each one needs more of the selection than a live block gives it.

| Effect | Effect ID | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Amplify | `audacity-amplify` | The no-clipping gain depends on the complete selection peak. |
| Change Pitch | `audacity-change-pitch` | This effect requires render-ahead selection processing. |
| Change Speed and Pitch | `audacity-change-speed-pitch` | This effect requires render-ahead selection processing. |
| Change Tempo | `audacity-change-tempo` | This effect requires render-ahead selection processing. |
| Fade In | `audacity-fade-in` | The gain curve depends on selection position and length. |
| Fade Out | `audacity-fade-out` | The gain curve depends on the future selection boundary. |
| Legacy Compressor | `audacity-legacy-compressor` | The algorithm performs whole-selection and backwards passes. |
| Loudness Normalization | `audacity-loudness-normalization` | The gain depends on complete-program loudness. |
| Normalize | `audacity-normalize` | DC offset and peak gain depend on complete-selection statistics. |
| Paulstretch | `audacity-paulstretch` | The effect changes duration and cannot be a one-in/one-out insert. |
| Remove DC Offset | `audacity-remove-dc-offset` | This effect requires render-ahead selection processing. |
| Repair | `audacity-repair` | Repair requires an explicitly marked short damaged selection and surrounding context. |
| Repeat | `audacity-repeat` | The effect changes duration and cannot be a one-in/one-out insert. |
| Reverb | `audacity-reverb` | This effect requires render-ahead selection processing. |
| Reverse | `audacity-reverse` | The first output sample depends on the end of the complete selection. |
| Sliding Stretch | `audacity-sliding-stretch` | This effect requires render-ahead selection processing. |
| Truncate Silence | `audacity-truncate-silence` | The effect removes time and cannot be a one-in/one-out insert. |
